description: This file defines the PrivilegeEditor class, which is a Java property editor for the Privilege class in the OpenMRS project. It provides methods to serialize and deserialize Privilege objects to and from string representations, facilitating form data binding and object retrieval by name or UUID.

classes.name: PrivilegeEditor
classes.description: A custom property editor that converts between Privilege objects and their String representations for web form binding.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a String to a Privilege object by name or UUID, setting the value for data binding.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the String representation of the Privilege object, typically its privilege name.
